logp.method_description: The log Pow values of complexes (Ru1-Ru3, Ru5-Ru6) were assessed utilizing a modified shake-flask method, as detailed in previous studies [23,35]. Octanol-saturated water (OSW) and water-saturated octanol (WSO) were prepared by vigorously shaking an equal-volume mixture of 1-octanol and water for 24 h. The two layers were then meticulously separated using a separating funnel. A volume of 250 μL of the complexes' methanol solution (approximately 2 μM/L) was introduced to 4 mL of WSO, which contained NaCl (100 μM/L). This mixture, amounting to 3800 μL, was then combined with an equal volume of OSW and subjected to magnetic stirring for 2 h at a controlled temperature of 37 °C. Subsequently, the aqueous layer was adeptly separated from the octanol layer to facilitate the analysis of the complexes' concentrations in both phases using UV–vis spectroscopy. The log Po/w was calculated as the logarithm of the ratio of the complexes' concentrations in the organic phase to that in the aqueous phase. To ensure the accuracy and reliability of the findings, each assessment was conducted thrice, with the results expressed as mean values ± SD.
